name: Nyx Glimmerstone
equipment: A letter from a dead colleague posing a question she has not yet been able to answer
A pouch of luminescent fungi samples
features: Darkvision (120 ft., Superior Darkvision as deep gnome)
Gnome Cunning (advantage on INT, WIS, and CHA saves against magic)
Stone Camouflage (advantage on Stealth checks in rocky terrain)
Spellcasting (Intelligence-based, prepare INT mod + wizard level spells per day)
Arcane Recovery (recover spell slots with combined level up to 2 on a short rest, once per day)
Illusion Savant (halved gold and time to copy illusion spells into spellbook)
Improved Minor Illusion (can create both sound and image with minor illusion)
Researcher (Sage feature: when you don't know information, you often know where to find it)

personality.traits: I am endlessly curious and cannot resist examining any new magical phenomenon, even when discretion would be wiser. I mutter to myself when thinking through problems and sometimes forget others are present. I keep meticulous notes on everything.
personality.ideals: Knowledge. Understanding the world is the greatest pursuit. Magic is not a tool of power but a lens through which we can perceive truths hidden from ordinary eyes.
personality.bonds: My mentor, the illusionist Brindlesprig, was killed by a mind flayer that stole his research on the Far Realm. I carry his unfinished spellbook and am determined to complete his work and avenge his death.
personality.flaws: My insatiable curiosity sometimes overrides my common sense, leading me into dangerous situations. I can be condescending about others' lack of magical knowledge, and I freeze up in social situations where charm matters more than intellect.

appearance: A diminutive deep gnome woman standing 3'2" with slate-gray skin and large, luminous dark eyes that seem to drink in every detail. Her head is bald in the svirfneblin fashion, and delicate, spiraling patterns of phosphorescent fungal ink are tattooed across her scalp and temples, faintly glowing in the dark. She wears practical gray robes over sturdy leather, festooned with pouches, scroll cases, and specimen jars containing glowing fungi. A battered but lovingly maintained spellbook hangs from a chain at her hip.
backstory: Nyx grew up in the svirfneblin settlement of Blingdenstone, where she apprenticed under the illusionist Brindlesprig, one of the finest magical minds among the deep gnomes. Together they studied the strange intersections between the Underdark's natural magical phenomena and the theory of illusion magic, believing that the deep places held secrets about the nature of reality itself. Their research attracted the attention of a mind flayer colony. The illithids raided Brindlesprig's workshop, killing the old gnome and stealing decades of research. Nyx escaped only because her mentor's final act was to weave an illusion so perfect that the mind flayers walked right past her. Now she carries his unfinished spellbook alongside her own, driven by a dual purpose: complete Brindlesprig's life work on the illusory nature of the Underdark's deepest places, and find and destroy the mind flayer that killed him.
